   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      4 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 24 jul 2026 - 12 oct 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _James Anderson_, 12 oct 2026, 1/5: "App freezes often."
            2. _Lucia_, 11 oct 2026, 1/5: "Constant crashes; it won't even open, and cycle tracking doesn't work and freezes the screen immediately. In the Together section, you have to repeatedly confirm the phone number about 10 times, otherwise it won't work, which is very annoying. It used to be a great app, but now it isn't."
            3. _Daniel Baumbart_, 27 sept 2026, 1/5: "202609: app doesn't crash a lot anymore but I can't delete wrong automatic entries in sleep so the data is wrong and will get worse over time :( 202509: crashes a lot since the newest update"
